text: directory — One row per Texas campus, district, region, state, one school year. name--identifier lookup behind txs_find_campus() txs_find_district(). Returned txs_directory().

title: Data dictionaries: every table txschools returns
text: tapr_student — Nine semantic datasets parsed TAPR campus district report’s student-information page, one requested entity-year per pull. Grain: one row per category value (e.g. one grade level) per entity-year basis. Returned inside named list txs_get_tapr(); datasets grade, ethnic, sex, cohorts, program, disability, mobility, attrition, retention share shape. category column named dataset: grade grade dataset (documented representative), ethnic, sex, cohort, program, disability, mobility, attrition, retention others. Every measure column travels <measure>_masked (true TEA suppressed value) <measure>_mask_code (verbatim suppression marker) companions.

title: Data dictionaries: every table txschools returns
text: tapr_class_size — Average class size grade subject one entity-year, campus, district, state comparison values. class_size dataset txs_get_tapr(). Grain: one row per class-size measure per entity-year. Shares identity columns tapr_student (year, school_year, level, geography, entity_name, district_name, county_name, source_url, retrieved_at, basis); measure columns differ documented . measure carries _masked/_mask_code companions tapr_student.

title: Data dictionaries: every table txschools returns

title: Data dictionaries: every table txschools returns
text: peims_finance — TEA’s statewide PEIMS single-file financial data: one row per district (charter) x fund x function x object x organizational unit x program intent, one school year basis. Returned txs_get_peims_finance(); also shape peims_finance_<basis>_<type>_<year> tables txs_write_peims_db() writes DuckDB. District actual files run several million rows per year. *_label, district_name, campus_name columns joined TEA’s companion code tables labels = TRUE (default) absent code tables fetched labels = FALSE. Charter files use TEA’s nonprofit chart accounts; asset/function/object/program-intent codes normalized columns. FERPA masking applies table: values dollar amounts, student counts. Negative amounts genuine (refunds, adjustments, contra accounts).

title: Data dictionaries: every table txschools returns
text: peims_meta — Written alongside every txs_write_peims_db() call: one row per table write, recording data came . Stored DuckDB _peims_meta.

title: Data dictionaries: every table txschools returns
text: tax_rates — One row per district per school year: adopted M&O &S property-tax rates merged Texas Comptroller’s annual rates--levies workbooks (tax years 2019 onward, primary) TEA’s adopted-tax-rates workbook (2005-06 onward, backfill). Returned txs_get_tax_rates(). Rates dollars per $100 taxable value. txs_derive_pennies() appends HB3 decomposition columns (tier_one_rate, golden_rate, copper_rate, enrichment_rate, golden_pennies, copper_pennies); NA whenever mcr NA. mcr user-supplied pluggable input – TEA publishes clean statewide Maximum Compressed Rate file – NA unless caller provides one.

title: Data dictionaries: every table txschools returns
text: first_ratings — One row per school district open-enrollment charter per rating year: TEA’s Financial Integrity Rating System Texas (FIRST) rating, School FIRST (districts, 2002-03 onward) Charter FIRST (charters, 2011-12 onward). Returned txs_get_first(). rating year’s ratings computed prior fiscal year’s audited financial data. rating system changed time, compare score within era: 2002-03 2013-14 used achievement labels (“Superior Achievement” “Substandard Achievement”) 65-85 point scales; 2014-15 pass/fail 30 points; 2015-16 ratings letter grades (, B, C, F) 100 points. University charters, rated pass/fail separate list since 2017-18, university_charter = true score. TEA posts preliminary ratings August final ratings mid-November; School FIRST labels every workbook “Final”, release marks district rows downloaded December 1 rating year preliminary, charter rows follow TEA’s label.

title: Data dictionaries: every table txschools returns
text: TEA — Texas Education Agency, state agency overseeing public K-12 education Texas. TAPR — Texas Academic Performance Reports (2013-present), TEA’s annual campus/district/region/state report cards; successor AEIS. AEIS — Academic Excellence Indicator System (2011-12), predecessor TAPR. SRC — School Report Card, condensed per-campus report TEA publishes alongside TAPR/AEIS. PEIMS — Public Education Information Management System, TEA’s statewide data collection; financial submission source peims_finance table. campus number — Nine-digit county-district-campus identifier; first six digits district number, last three campus. Always handled zero-padded string. district number — Six-digit identifier district open-enrollment charter (charters share district number space). ending year — package identifies school years ending calendar year: 2025 means 2024-25 school year, matching TEA’s URLs. masking — FERPA-driven suppression TEA applies small student counts. Masked cells keep verbatim marker (“*“,”.”, “<1%”, -1 style sentinels) value/mask_code, masked = true null numeric value. Never imputed. applicable PEIMS finance (dollars, students). fund — Revenue source bucket TEA’s chart accounts (e.g. 199 general fund, 211 Title , 240 school nutrition, 599 debt service). function — Purpose expenditure TEA’s chart accounts (e.g. 11 instruction, 23 school leadership, 51 facility maintenance operations, 71 debt service). object — bought received (e.g. 61xx payroll, 62xx contracted services, 66xx capital outlay; 5xxx revenues). program intent — Student population expenditure intended serve (e.g. 11 basic educational services, 23 special education). fin unit — Organizational unit within district PEIMS finance; campus number money attributable campus, otherwise “000” (cost center) “999” (undistributed). charter — Open-enrollment charter school, reported TEA nonprofit chart accounts PEIMS finance districts tables. FIRST — Financial Integrity Rating System Texas, TEA’s annual financial accountability rating every district (School FIRST) charter (Charter FIRST), based prior fiscal year’s audited financial data; source first_ratings table. ESC region — One twenty Education Service Center regions Texas districts belong (e.g. Region 12, Waco).

title: Masking and suppression in TEA data
text: Display formatting stripped numeric parsing — "97%" parses 97 (printed, divided 100) "$4,668" 4668: package-wide convention: numeric values kept scale TEA printed . one exception semantic TAPR student datasets txs_get_tapr(), whose columns explicitly named *_percent proportions ("49.6%" becomes 0.496) — column name declares unit. title: Polite, Reproducible Access to Texas Education Agency Public Performance Data
text: txschools provides reproducible, polite, -demand access public school-performance data published Texas Education Agency (TEA): TAPR (Texas Academic Performance Reports, 2013-present): per-campus semantic datasets via txs_get_tapr(), statewide data files via txs_get_tapr_file(), variable dictionary via txs_get_tapr_dictionary(). SRC (School Report Card, 2004-2019): per-campus reports via txs_get_src() – parsed tidy data 2004-2012 HTML era, cached PDFs 2013-2019. (2020+ SRC lives txschools.gov, package scrape.) AEIS (Academic Excellence Indicator System, 2004-2012): statewide data files via txs_get_aeis(). PEIMS financial data (1999-2000-present): statewide fund/function/object-level district charter budgets actuals via txs_get_peims_finance(), optional DuckDB output via txs_write_peims_db(). Property tax rates (2005-06-present): district M&O/&S rates Texas Comptroller TEA workbooks via txs_get_tax_rates(), interactive map explorer (txs_viewer()). FIRST financial ratings (2002-03-present): TEA’s Financial Integrity Rating System Texas ratings every district charter via txs_get_first(). Every table functions return documented machine-readable data dictionary – column types, ranges, masking semantics, relationships, glossary TEA terms – data-dict.yaml format, shipped package: vignette("data-dictionaries") renders full dictionary – every table, column column, plus relationships TEA glossary – generated file.

title: Polite, Reproducible Access to Texas Education Agency Public Performance Data
text: TEA publishes statewide TAPR data “Advanced Download” interface one file per level dataset code ("REF" reference information, "STAAR1" STAAR performance, "GRAD" graduation, …). txs_get_tapr_file() downloads one files; use txs_list_downloads() see codes TEA publishes year, txs_get_tapr_dictionary() variable-code dictionary.
code: # Every Texas campus's reference row, one call: ref_2024 <- txs_get_tapr_file(2024, "campus", dataset = "REF", output = "raw")  # What do those variable codes mean? dict_2024 <- txs_get_tapr_dictionary(2024, "campus")

title: Polite, Reproducible Access to Texas Education Agency Public Performance Data
text: txs_get_src() pulls one campus’s School Report Card: parsed tidy masking-aware tibble 2004-2012 (TEA’s HTML era), downloaded cached official PDF 2013-2019. txs_get_aeis() pulls statewide AEIS data files (2004-2012) level dataset code:
code: src_2011 <- txs_get_src(2011, "campus", "161920102") aeis_2011 <- txs_get_aeis(2011, "district", dataset = "ref",                           geography = "161920")

title: Polite, Reproducible Access to Texas Education Agency Public Performance Data
text: txs_get_peims_finance() pulls TEA’s statewide PEIMS financial data: fund/function/object-level budgets actuals every district (every charter school) one school year, 1999-2000 onward. tidy output joins human-readable labels account codes plus district campus names, analysis-ready: call downloads (caches) one statewide file, multi-year district history just mapped pull: year costs one request first time read disk . China Spring ISD decade: Summarizing operating expenditures (objects 6100-6499) function area shows district’s dollars go shifted district grown:  Mind scale: district actual file single ~30 MB download parses several million rows, decade moves ~300 MB first run (nothing ).
